comportamentos: Treat a missing link.prop("search") as an empty string before calling .replace, in all three partials (notifications, queries, assertions): present
Fall back to an empty object when queryStringToHash(p) returns a falsy value (queryStringToHash(p) || {}), so params[...] assignment does not throw: missing
justificativa: The candidate guards the .replace call in all three partials but omits the official `|| {}` fallback on queryStringToHash. If that function returns undefined or null for an empty query string, the handler still throws a TypeError. The added DOM-ready wrapper does not cover that case either.
